summary: Wave-1 (Reports & Analytics, In-app Notifications, Payment receipt PDF) tested end-to-end. Backend: 15/15 pytest tests pass, covering report shape, CSV export content-type, per-department RBAC on /reports/{sales,financial,activity} for admin/sales-head/accounts-head/legal-head/crm-head/BDE, notification listing+scoping+ownership+mark-all, payment creation notification for Accounts Head (title contains amount), and receipt PDF starting with %PDF. Frontend: verified nav-reports, tabs (report-tab-sales/financial/activity), export CSV/PDF buttons, ₹ rendering, notif-bell + notif-panel + notif-mark-all clearing notif-badge, and RBAC (Sales Head sees only Sales+Activity, Accounts Head sees only Financial+Activity, Admin sees all).

minor.issue: Response shape is {payment: {...}} (wrapped) instead of returning the created resource at top level; other endpoints often use {data: {...}}. Not incorrect but inconsistent.

integration_issues.issue: Admin is auto-routed to #/onboarding on fresh sessions which hides the sidebar/topbar. Reports and bell are only reachable after completing/skipping onboarding or navigating to #/reports directly. Not a wave-1 bug but affects first-run UX for admin.

action_items: Optional: standardize payment create response envelope ({data:{...}} or top-level) for API consistency.
Optional: for admins with must_change_password=false and onboarding already completed, skip the #/onboarding auto-redirect on login.
critical_code_review_comments: RBAC on /reports/* correctly enforced via permission middleware (reports.sales / reports.financial / reports.activity) — verified 200/403 across 6 roles.
Notification ownership check on POST /notifications/{id}/read correctly returns 403 for non-owner.
Payment creation triggers notifyPermission to Accounts Head — verified unread increment and INR amount rendered in title.
Receipt endpoint returns application/pdf with proper %PDF header (~108KB via headless Chrome). Consider caching or timeout guard for cold Chrome start.
seed_data_creation: Test payment created with reference prefix QA-TEST-<hex> against an existing booking; attempted DELETE cleanup best-effort. Notifications generated for accounts head users during test (small residual).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Wave-1 backend + frontend verified. Test file at /app/backend/tests/test_wave1_features.py can be reused. Note: Laravel app is served at http://localhost:8000 (not React on 3000); the preview URL only proxies frontend port. Use localhost:8000 for Playwright. Admin lands on #/onboarding after login — navigate to #/reports for direct testing.
